title: Filipino Pork Adobo Wrap
description: A flavorful twist on traditional wraps, this Filipino pork adobo wrap combines tender pork, tangy sauce, and crunchy veggies in a warm and spicy tortilla.
instructions: In a large pan, heat 2 tablespoons of oil over medium heat.
Add the pork and cook until browned, about 5 minutes.
Add the vinegar, soy sauce, garlic, onion, tomato, and bell pepper.
Stir well and bring to a simmer.
Reduce heat to low and cook, covered, for 10 minutes.
Stir in the chopped spinach and cook for 1 minute.
Warm the tortilla by wrapping it in a damp paper towel and microwaving for 20-30 seconds.
Assemble the wrap by spooning the pork mixture onto the tortilla.
Drizzle with spicy mayonnaise and serve immediately.
